events.who_did_what: Eulalia 把见面地点从 Callie 最初拿到的 Primrose Hill 地址改成 Tate Britain（理由：她想见 ‘somewhere awe-inspiring’），并且是 last minute 改的。Callie 走过被炮弹打坏的墙进入馆内，上旋转楼梯，在礼品店买了明信片对照，然后找到约好站在其对面的画；Callie 看了表——早了五分钟，仍不知道 Eulalia 长什么样。

Callie 坐在长椅上，面对 Ellen Terry 演的 Lady Macbeth 那幅画（Lady M 双臂把皇冠举过头顶；衣裙上的钴蓝闪光是用数千只宝石甲虫翅膀做的）。Callie 猜甲虫是被熏死的还是活着被拔翅。她想：如果 Eulalia 想要 ‘mad’，为什么是 Lady M 不是 Ophelia；她自己的作品更接近 Millais（Millais 在相邻展厅），她喜欢 Rossetti 但觉得他是个 wanker。Callie 查手机——换地点之后 Eulalia 那边一点消息也没有。她补了口红（Liberty’s 买的 sheer russet，两年前和 Max 难捱时买的），用 1950 年代古董化妆镜照了照，被身后一个盯着她看的年轻女人吓了一跳。

第一句搭话：Callie 说 ‘Jesus Christ on a bicycle…’ 并说 ‘I take it you’re …’；Eulalia 以很轻的 sotto voce 回 ‘Yes, that’s me’，并伸手说 ‘Calliope, delighted to meet you at last.’。Callie 注意到 Eulalia 未施粉黛、穿宽大运动裤和 2XL 男式 T 恤、戴棒球帽——像藏在袋里的维纳斯。

Eulalia 的握手无力、随即松开，甩身坐上长椅，**不看 Callie**，仰头看画说 ‘She’s so fucking angry. I love it.’。Callie 问 ‘Is it her air of unpredictability that you like?’（探询式提问），Eulalia 给出宣言：‘Women should be unpredictable. We already are… Men are constants; they’re boring… Cholera in trousers.’ Callie 回 ‘In my experience that depends on the man.’，并在 Smythson 皮面本上写下 ‘unpredictable’、‘female anger’、‘wild-eyed’。

Eulalia 说 ‘I’m so happy you agreed to this. I’ve been feeling really lost.’，随即抓住 Callie 的手，并说妹妹 Mel 一切都替她安排（‘My sister Mel is amazing; she organises everything for me. My deals with my label, all the business stuff.’），但紧接着压低声音批评 Mel：她没有 creative mindset、不能 freewheel ideas、‘She doesn’t understand the pursuit of beauty.’

一个穿白衬衫黑西裤的女人从画旁盯着她们；Eulalia 介绍 ‘Mel, this is Cal; Cal, this is Mel.’。Callie 猜 Mel 可能全程都在，只是自己太专注于 Eulalia 而没注意。Mel 说她要去见 PCQV 的人、Callie 不用管，然后对 Eulalia 说 ‘You need to be back by 3 p.m. at the latest. Have you got your Oyster? Your phone in case I need to reach you.’；Eulalia 答 ‘Yep.’（拍口袋）。Mel 临走时从包里递给 Eulalia 一瓶水，说 ‘Don’t get dehydrated. It’s far too hot out there.’；两姐妹互相做开枪手势。

Callie 问 ‘Where in the North are you from?’；Eulalia 反问 ‘How could you tell?’（她一直在努力装 posh 腔，Mel 建议她学 elocution lesson）；Callie 说 ‘The humour in your work feels northern. I expected you to be from Yorkshire.’；Eulalia 说 ‘God’s own country.’ 并翻白眼，Callie 说 ‘See, only people from Yorkshire say that.’，Eulalia 认输：‘All right, you’ve got me. I’m a Yorkshire lass born and bred.’ Callie 说自己母亲的家族来自那一带。

Callie 问 ‘Do you like Millais?’，Eulalia 答 ‘No. I don’t care for him.’；她们走到 Millais 的 Ophelia 前，Callie 问 ‘Too inactive?’，Eulalia 说 ‘She’s pitiful. Ophelia has things done to her and doesn’t do a thing for herself… she’s fucking weak. I hate that she goes mad and that makes her fuckable.’，Callie 回 ‘Viragos not damsels.’，Eulalia 说 ‘I don’t like guys at the moment. I’m all about the divine feminine.’；Eulalia 说喜欢 Joan of Arc、Julian of Norwich、‘Batshit-crazy nuns’、‘Straight-up schizophrenia channelled into religious revelational energy’、‘God’s a woman. God’s a mother.’，并说 ‘That’s why I bought my house.’，然后提议边走边谈业务。

走到 Millbank 长椅上，Eulalia 念手机：‘What I want from you is the thought behind a cohesive aesthetic…’ ‘I hate it but I’m a brand. We estimate that I have five years to make all the money I can… I’m going to get fabulously rich and then I’ll make my legacy works.’ Callie 问 ‘What exactly do you mean by creative work?’ 并继续记笔记（动作掩盖了 growing sense of inadequacy）。Eulalia 界定：服装、专辑封面与相关美术品、周边 merch、社交媒体帖子；品牌＝packaging、logos。厂牌之前做的是 neon latex 与 glitter，感觉 ‘chopped’，已给 Eulalia 两周另做方案。PCQV 全是 Mel 的主意（先谈成一串商业代言、把美学先卖给 PCQV，逼厂牌跟着走），现在做美妆线（lip oils、cream blushes），在高端百货与 Sephora 卖；Mel 处于谈判早期；下周要给品牌感觉做 pitch；PCQV 的 mock-up 是 soft and gentle pinks，而她是 violent-colour-riot、bright reds、oranges、anything flammable、unrealistically anachronistic、theatrical。

Callie 猜 ‘Performance art meets Renaissance fayre?’，Eulalia 回 ‘Exactly.’ 并说看到花园里那段视频就想到 ‘that girl is like me… You’re an ancient soul trapped in the body of a hot thirty-yearold.’。Eulalia 问 ‘The guy in the cast, that was your boyfriend, right? What is he?’；Callie 答 ‘It’s his job. He’s a professional dragonslayer.’；Eulalia 问 ‘He rescues a lot of damsels?’，Callie 答 ‘Oh yeah, me included.’；Eulalia 问 ‘Did I read something about his family?’，Callie 答 ‘His dad is a baronet. He’s a Sir… Caius’s grandfather inherited it last year after the previous titleholder’s parentage came to light.’；Eulalia 说 ‘Maybe Lady. I like the assonance.’ 并记在手机上。

威斯敏斯特教堂：Eulalia 先到售票亭，订了两张票外加 hefty guidebooks；Callie 付了 £70。Eulalia 说 ‘Invoice Mel for the tickets. I don’t have any money on me. Only my Oyster card.’；Callie 问 ‘Don’t you just tap in and out with your phone?’，Eulalia 说自己没 contactless，并说 ‘Retro. So Y2K.’。堂内 Eulalia 说 ‘Samuel Pepys was a creepy little fucker’（Callie 回 ‘What?’），并讲 Catherine of Valois 的陵墓失修、Pepys 掀开亲吻她嘴唇并写进日记；Eulalia 说 Elizabeth I ‘Such a baddie’，两人谈 ruffs（Callie 说政府想把 ruffs 变成国服，Eulalia 说 ‘They take up space.’，Callie 接 ‘True.’，Eulalia ‘I want to take up space.’）；Callie 在 Poets’ Corner 问 ‘Do you have a favourite?’，Eulalia 答 ‘The Brontës. I’m from Yorkshire.’

离开教堂：Eulalia 说 ‘That was so fucking cool.’；Callie 努力不皱眉（她盯着门上的 Martin Luther King），觉得 Eulalia 轻佻的语气让她不舒服；Eulalia 挽住她手臂，几乎押着她走向 Westminster 站；Big Ben 敲整点。Callie 把话题拉回专业：‘How do you want to proceed?’；Eulalia 说 Mel 会把要给厂牌 pitch 的全部创意资产清单 emailed 给 Callie，mock-ups 太多但要 visual reference points、mood boards、influences 给产品设计团队，‘Let’s meet again this week before the presentation. We’ve got a short turnaround on this.’，然后拥抱 Callie 并说 ‘This was a great meeting, Cal. We’re going to work so well together.’；Callie 客气附和，看着她跑向 Embankment。
Callie 进 Westminster 站地铁时想：她担心的不是咬下太多，而是会不会把自己噎死；Eulalia 大概是可爱的，创意人往往 intense、界限松、有未确诊的 ADHD；只要稍微保持距离，工作应该还行；她不打算被吸进去变成朋友；项目本身界定不清、周期短、她状态也不佳；她甩了甩头——她不会容忍朋友这样 nonsense，也不该容忍自己这样。

relations: Callie（Calliope）——受聘的品牌/美学顾问；本章第一次见 Eulalia 本人；用 Smythson 皮面笔记本（只在客户咨询时用，'lent her authority'）
Eulalia——女歌手/名人，品牌主；本章首次与 Callie 见面；雇 Callie 的人（通过 Mel 转达 pitch 清单）
Mel——Eulalia 的妹妹兼经纪人；'organises everything for me'；在 PCQV 商业谈判早期；管 Eulalia 的时间（3 p.m. 前回家）、给她做计划；与 Eulalia 长相有家族相似但无共同特征；不施粉黛、衣着老练昂贵

Caius——Callie 的男友，警察（'He's a police officer.'）；职业是 'professional dragonslayer'；家里有男爵头衔（His dad is a baronet / He's a Sir），祖父去年继承（'Caius's grandfather inherited it last year after the previous titleholder's parentage came to light'）；Callie 说若被知道会说 'He's a hero then' → 'Don't ever tell him that'
Max——Callie 的前任，两年前与她难捱时她买了那支 sheer russet 口红（只提及）
Nell——Saturday evening 用那种眼神看过 Caius 的人（只提及）
Callie 的母亲家族来自 Yorkshire 方向（'My mum's family are from out that way.'）
PCQV——法国奢侈品集团；Eulalia 品牌合作方；与厂牌形成对照
厂牌（label）——Eulalia 的唱片公司；给了她两周另提方案；之前做 neon latex 与 glitter，被 Mel 和 Eulalia 评为 'chopped'
